shared_components.name: ActionCard
shared_components.notes: Card with icon, label, description, chevron. Accent tinting via data-accent prop.

shared_components.name: ActionIcon
shared_components.notes: 36x36 icon container. Accent background tint. Accepts any SVG children.

shared_components.name: BrandLogo
shared_components.notes: 42x42 gradient logo tile with kanban grid SVG icon.

shared_components.name: StatusCard
shared_components.notes: Ambient status strip with animated dot and text. Lives at bottom of home view.

naming_rules.no_duplicates: If a component name already exists in shared_components, reuse or extend it via props instead of creating a second version.
naming_rules.no_per_screen_variants: Do not create HomeActionCard, SidebarActionCard, etc. Use props to vary behavior.
naming_rules.accent_pattern: Color variation on components is handled by the data-accent prop, not by creating accent-specific subcomponents.
